adj.description: Adjacency matrix: $1$ if location $a$ is adjacent to $a'$, $0$ otherwise

r.description: Reward earned for a class $k$ flight being at location $a$ in time period $t$

cap.description: Capacity of sector $a$ in time period $t$, shared by all plane classes

notes: We identify a number of modeling inconsistencies in the original pair of formulations. To address this, we propose a new pair of flow-based formulations. The efficient formulation `p13.a` is an aggregated version of `p13.b`.

The original problem is not NP-hard: the flights aggregate into one commodity on a time-expanded flow network, so it reduces to a single-commodity min-cost flow problem and is solvable in polynomial time. We introduce multiple plane classes, which earn class-dependent rewards and share the location capacities, to make the problem NP-hard.
We add implicit assumptions that all sets are non-empty ($nK, nA, nT \geq 1$), that every location is adjacent to itself ($\text{adj}_{a,a} = 1$), and that $\text{cap}_{a,t}, nP_k \geq 0$.
